items.title: The operation of capping with a first Chern class factors through rational equivalence
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the operation of capping with a first Chern class descends from cycles to the Chow group: on rationally trivial cycles it vanishes (statement lines 4947-4957, tag 02TI). The proof is a real reduction: it unfolds rational equivalence into a locally finite sum of principal divisors, uses the projection formula for the cap to reach the disjoint union of the components, reduces to a single integral scheme, and then invokes commutativity on an integral scheme together with additivity to see that the resulting expression vanishes. The two-step reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
